intro.title: Digital Family Map
intro.description: A unique model that classifies families into five categories of well-being (from A to E) based on 100 socio-economic criteria. Developed in collaboration with UNDP, the Digital Family Map uses the Alkire-Foster methodology to measure multidimensional poverty.

nitec.title: NIT JSC – Operator of the National Artificial Intelligence Platform
nitec.description:
On January 23, 2024, NIT JSC was appointed as the operator of the National Artificial Intelligence Platform. Among the key initiatives is the development of the Digital Family Map module for the Government of Kazakhstan.
The module tracks real-time changes in the well-being of families across Kazakhstan's regions, determining the key factors that influenced the transition between categories. Using artificial intelligence algorithms, the system creates local support programs to improve well-being, which can be applied by local executive authorities.
